<function name="BatteryPower" parent="system" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the current battery power.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">0-100 if a battery (laptop, UPS, etc) is present.

Will instead return 255 if plugged in without a battery.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
